_meta.what_this_is: Three tool results an agent got back in one turn, each a list of output lines. The line that matters -- the final result or the error -- is the LAST line of each result, which is where tools put their conclusion. The results are big (10, 12, 8 lines) and the context window only has room for 20 lines total. How you fit them in decides whether the agent still has the answers.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. The results and their sizes are hand-authored so that appending them whole overflows the 20-line window (dropping a whole result), head-only truncation fits but cuts off every salient last line, and head+tail truncation fits AND keeps every last line. Every packed transcript and count is computed in truncate.py.
_meta.format: window_lines: total context budget; per_result_cap: max lines kept per result when truncating; results: [{name, lines:[...]}] with the salient line last.
